src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2020_us_cd116_500k
cd.vint: The Census Bureau's lines of the 116th Congress's districts (its file says session 116). The Bureau published no file of the 117th Congress's districts, the Congress the 2020 election chose.
rec: 2011 congressional plan, 9 districts (House Enrolled Act 1602, P.L. 215-2011)
Indiana General Assembly: House Bill 1581 (2021), redistricting, reprinted 2021-09-23 (copy at All About Redistricting)

House Enrolled Act 1601 (P.L. 214-2011) for the legislature and House Enrolled Act 1602 (P.L. 215-2011) for Congress; both passed 2011-05-04, signed 2011-05-10 (dates from the secondary source); the P.L. numbers are read from HB 1581 (2021), which cites them. In force 2012-2020. The cd116 file has 9 districts.

src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2020_us_sldu_500k
sldu.vint: The Census Bureau's 2020 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2018 legislative session year. The Bureau published no file of the lines in use for 2020. Where a state's lines changed in between, the check below or the plan cited stops the map.
rec: 2011 legislative plan, 50 Senate districts (House Enrolled Act 1601, P.L. 214-2011)
Indiana General Assembly: House Enrolled Act 1601 (2011), the general assembly (copy hosted by Vote Smart)

House Enrolled Act 1601 (P.L. 214-2011) for the legislature and House Enrolled Act 1602 (P.L. 215-2011) for Congress; both passed 2011-05-04, signed 2011-05-10 (dates from the secondary source); the P.L. numbers are read from HB 1581 (2021), which cites them. The 2020 file (LSY 2018) holds it. 25 Senate seats were up in 2020.
